question: BR Ambedkar wrote a 20-page autobiography about his experiences with untouchability which is known as _________.
solution: The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Waiting for a Visa is a 20-page autobiographical life story of B.R.
